# Krupashindu - Mineral Water Plant Manufacturers & Turnkey Bottling Plant Solutions

Krupashindu (Krupashindu Consulting Engineers) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified **Mineral Water Plant Manufacturer**, exporter, and turnkey engineering consultant. Established in 2005 and headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India, Krupashindu delivers custom-engineered **Mineral Water Plants**, high-speed **Bottling Plants**, and **Packaged Drinking Water Plants** across India and 30+ countries worldwide.

## Core Turnkey Machinery & Solutions
1. **Mineral Water Plant:** Complete multi-stage purification and bottling setups (2,000 to 20,000 BPH) designed for BIS/ISI/FSSAI compliance with food-grade SS 316L piping.
2. **Bottling Plant:** High-speed monoblock Rinsing-Filling-Capping (RFC) machines (24 to 300 BPM), automatic bottle blowing, and shrink wrapping lines.
3. **Packaged Drinking Water Plant:** Turnkey commercial setups with industrial RO filtration, UV sterilization, ozonation skids, and in-house testing laboratory setups.
4. **Mineral Water Plant Manufacturers:** Custom machinery engineering, factory layout drafting, civil planning, and export-grade turnkey machinery fabrication.
5. **Fruit Juice Plant & CSD Lines:** Integrated pulp processing, pasteurizers, hot-fill blocks, carbonators, and carbonated soft drink lines.
6. **Industrial RO Plant & Water Softener:** High-recovery commercial Reverse Osmosis systems (1,000 LPH to 50,000 LPH).

## Turnkey Services & Engineering Support
- **Site Layout & Planning:** Designing clean-room environments to meet stringent ISI/BIS regulatory hygiene standards.
- **BIS (ISI) & FSSAI Licensing Assistance:** Guided consulting on regulatory paperwork, in-house standard testing labs, and audit preparation.
- **Installation & Commissioning:** On-site mechanical, piping, and electrical integration by expert engineers.
- **After-Sales Support:** Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC), 24/7 technical helpdesk, genuine spare parts inventory, and remote video troubleshooting.
